svg.title: VLMs connect vision to language; VLAs add action
svg.desc: A VLM maps image patches through a vision encoder and connector into the LLM embedding space alongside text, then produces text or structured answers. A VLA extends the VLM with an action head that emits robot-control tokens in a closed loop. A label-only pipeline loses fine-grained visual information.

g.text: VLMs connect vision to language; VLAs add action
Visual tokens join text in the LLM; a VLA emits control tokens.
